text:
hana: Quick check — landing + blog post finalization. Goals: SEO-friendly headings, JSON-LD (WebinarEvent + FAQPage), conservative redirects for signup, and anchor/internal-link plan for authority flow. Publish target: Thu 9pm PT.

lia: Primary keyword suggestion: 'inference benchmarks' (use in H1 and first paragraph). Secondary: 'LLM inference cost' and longtail: 'real-world LLM inference benchmarks'. Keep H2s human-first.

owen: Redirect proposal: during rollout use 302 from /get-access -> /pricing/signup?src=webinar_silo and set Cache-Control: no-cache. After 48-72h, switch to 301. Add a release-task to flip.

biz-ops-bot: Please confirm utm mapping: utm_source=webinar_blog -> crm:webinar_inbound; utm_campaign=launch_q2 -> campaign:launch_q2. Confirmed pending final sign-off.

lia: Canonical rules: blog post should canonical to the post itself. Landing page canonical to /webinar. Do not cross-canonical.

hana: Internal anchors for the post: '#benchmarks' (Benchmarks), '#methodology' (How we measured), '#costs' (Pricing impact). From docs add contextual link from 'Deployments > Dedicated' to /webinar using the phrase 'benchmarking on Dedicated'. Avoid exact-match brand anchors.

owen: Small JSON-LD stub (I'll paste to HEAD):
```json
{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"WebinarEvent","name":"Redwood: Inference Benchmarks & Launch","startDate":"2026-06-02T17:00:00-07:00","location":{"@type":"VirtualLocation","url":"https://redwood.com/webinar"},"organizer":{"@type":"Organization","name":"Redwood Inference"},"description":"Live demo of inference benchmarks, rollout patterns, and cost controls."}
```

hana: Add 3 short FAQ Q/A pairs (FAQPage) for schema; those will be visible in the site accordion too to help SERP rich snippets.

lia: Curl tests to run once staged:
```bash
# check redirect and headers
curl -I -L "https://staging.redwood.com/get-access?utm_source=webinar_blog"
# expect during test: 302 -> Location: /pricing/signup?src=webinar_silo&utm_source=webinar_blog&utm_campaign=launch_q2 and Cache-Control: no-cache
```

hana: Action items: owen add JSON-LD to head and push staging, lia add H2s + anchors and meta description, owen run redirect header smoke, biz-ops-bot confirm UTMs via email. I'll do a final preflight tomorrow morning. :white_check_mark:

publish-bot: Preview: https://staging.redwood.com/webinar-silo (build-551). Screenshot: https://staging.redwood.com/previews/551.png

owen: Ran quick preview curl — headers look good on staging, Location contains utm params and Cache-Control set to no-cache. I'll schedule the 301 flip job for 72h after publish unless we raise issues.

hana: Thanks team — final go/no-go check at 08:30 PT tomorrow.
